Problem Statement
Read an integer and determine whether it is even or odd using an if-else statement.
Description
Read an integer num from input. Use the % operator to check if num is exactly divisible by 2. If the remainder is 0, print "Even"; otherwise print "Odd". Use a single if-else statement to make this decision.
Input Description
A single integer num.
Output Description
Print "Even" if num is even, otherwise print "Odd".
Sample Input
7
Sample Output
Odd
